sanskrit_verse:
स्वरन्ध्रगोप्तान्वीक्षिक्यां दण्डनीत्यां तथैव च /
विनीतस् त्व् अथ वार्तायां त्रय्यां चैव नराधिपः // YajñS_1.311
transliteration: svarandhragoptānvīkṣikyāṁ daṇḍanītyāṁ tathaiva ca / vinītas tv atha vārtāyāṁ trayyāṁ caiva narādhipaḥ // YajñS_1.311
sph_interpretive_translation: The ruler who protects the sovereignty of the inner realm, governs with the science of governance, administers justice through corrective alignment, and conducts himself with humility in economic matters and Vedic principles—such a king embodies true kingship.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation arises from dharmic alignment rather than coercive force
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by internal discipline and outer conduct
Restoration logic operates through self-regulation before external correction
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler fails to protect svarandhra THEN legitimacy deficit triggers automatic review by dharma-advisory council
IF policy lacks alignment with vīkṣikī THEN implementation suspended until pramāṇa-based validation
IF corrective measures exceed daṇḍa-nīti bounds THEN reversal protocol initiated via nyāya tribunal
IF economic activity violates trayī THEN mandatory reintegration process begins at source-level capacity
IF ruler demonstrates vinaya THEN enhanced jurisdiction granted automatically within constitutional framework
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that sovereign authority is conditional upon maintaining alignment between consciousness, governance, and Vedic principle. The threshold of responsibility lies not in punitive enforcement but in demonstrable integrity of rule. When misalignment occurs, restoration protocols activate prior to judicial intervention, ensuring realignment precedes resolution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that improper governance manifests sequentially: first loss of inner sovereignty (svarandhra), then breakdown in corrective systems (daṇḍanīti), followed by economic distortion (vārtā). Thus, proportional responsibility flows from causal sequence. Punishment has no place; correction aligns with natural consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svarandhra purification process for ruler's consciousness realignment
Deploy vīkṣikī advisory council to restore pramāṇa-grounded governance
Activate daṇḍanīti reset mechanism to recalibrate corrective frameworks
Engage trayī-based economic rehabilitation for affected communities
Reinforce vinaya cultivation program for leadership reconditioning
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma stands restored through conscious alignment, not punitive coercion. Reality itself adjudicates through awakened awareness. Consciousness alone is the ultimate judge.
